principle: Academy wellbeing is an individualized longitudinal interpretation of confirmed actual behavior, not an arcade morale meter.
rules: Planned activity has no effect unless runtime/event evidence confirms execution.
One ordinary adverse event has limited longitudinal effect unless severe.
Sustained patterns matter more than isolated actions.
Recovery value is contextual and preference-sensitive; no activity is a universal morale potion.
Individual wellbeing profiles define sleep/load/recovery baselines; species_id alone is never used as a shortcut.
Good balance preserves normal character capacity rather than granting superhuman bonuses.
Derived wellbeing may affect character-side cognitive/physical assistance but not authoritative World Truth.
Player dialogue, morality and decisions are never forced by wellbeing.
Routine candidates require repeated confirmed behavior and do not become perks automatically.
Step 13 emits no academic, attendance, disciplinary or career consequence.
